_comment: Cross-language golden for the content-addressed quote_hash = "0x"+hex(keccak256(SigningInput)) of each signed FulfillmentQuote fixture. The Go conformance_test.go (ComputeQuoteHash) and the TS conformance.test.ts (computeQuoteHash) both assert their output equals these values; if both match this file, they match each other. The normalizing keccak256 makes every cryptosuite a uniform 32-byte (66-char) value. quote_hash ignores the non-deterministic JWS/proofValue, so the -go-signed and -ts-signed fixtures of a given cryptosuite share content + proof metadata and therefore the same hash. Regenerate per conformance/README.md.
